nodes.rationale: Tasks 2-9 run in parallel worktrees after Task 1 foundation completes. Each owns a grammar module and implements corresponding test corpus.

nodes.label: Wave 2: Convergence and Merge
nodes.rationale: Task 10 merges all wave-1 branches to main, resolves GLR conflicts, regenerates parser, validates full corpus green.

nodes.label: Wave 3: Packaging and Integration
nodes.rationale: Tasks 11-13 build Python wheel, verify language() loads, and integrate with Graphify for extraction.

nodes.label: Tree-sitter Modular Grammar Architecture
nodes.rationale: Grammar split into modules (literals, identifiers, functions, expression, qsql, control, commands) merged via Object.assign(). Each module independently testable, each wave-1 task owns one module.

nodes.label: Right-to-Left (RTL) Expression Model
nodes.rationale: q has no operator precedence; every dyadic operation binds right. Implemented as right-recursive binary fold: binary = prec.right(seq(left:_application, operator, right:_expression)). Ensures 2*3+4 parses right-nested.

nodes.label: GLR Conflict Resolution Strategy
nodes.rationale: Four conflicts intentionally kept: symbol_vector/_primary (single vs repeat), call/index (q resolves at eval), call/_application (juxtaposition), builtin/select (keyword reuse). Others removed via prec/structure. Task 10 reconciles across all branches.

nodes.label: External Scanner Token Set
nodes.rationale: Seven external tokens: COMMENT (line/block), SYSTEM_COMMAND_TOK (backslash), NEG_NUMBER (whitespace-sensitive), LIST_WS (vector separator), ADVERB_TOK (postfix iterator), EOS (statement terminator), ERROR_SENTINEL.

nodes.label: Frozen Node Type Taxonomy
nodes.rationale: Complete rule-name set frozen after Task 1: assignment, lambda, parameters, call, index, binary, adverb_apply, select_statement, control, cond, plus 20+ literal types. All downstream tasks reference these names.

nodes.label: Namespace Qualification (\d)
nodes.rationale: Scanner emits SYSTEM_COMMAND_TOK for backslash commands; parser defers \d to namespace_directive rule. Namespace state tracked by Graphify extractor for function/variable scoping.

nodes.label: q-SQL Computed Column Syntax
nodes.rationale: Phrases inside select/exec/update/delete clauses are `;`-separated expressions. To support col:expr naming, _expression is overridden in qsql.js to include assignment, allowing column-def within phrase context.

nodes.label: macOS Tree-sitter Dylib Cache Clash
nodes.rationale: Grammar name 'q' shared across worktrees caches ~.../Library/Caches/tree-sitter/lib/q.dylib. Always use tree-sitter test --rebuild in worktrees; prevents stale binary loading.

nodes.label: Graphify Extractor Contract
nodes.rationale: Extractor returns {nodes:[{id, name, kind, line}], edges:[{src, dst, relation, line, confidence}]}. Kinds: file, function, variable. Relations: contains, calls, imports, uses. Namespace-aware via \d tracking.
